summary: Backend testing for American Accent Coach completed. All 20 pytest cases passed (100% success). Validated health, sound-categories (19 entries), PDF upload (with non-PDF rejection), list/get/delete scenes, phonetic correctness for 'butter' and 'little', laundry-list filtering for all 7 requested sound categories, and TTS endpoint behavior (returns expected 502 with upstream 401 detected_unusual_activity, as documented).

minor.issue: Returns 502 from ElevenLabs free-tier 'detected_unusual_activity' — EXPECTED with current free key on cloud IPs. Not a bug. A paid key would unblock real synthesis + audio_cache writes.

action_items: Optional: provide a paid ElevenLabs API key to enable real TTS audio synthesis and audio_cache validation in production.
Optional minor: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); consider migrating to lifespan handlers in a future cleanup pass.
critical_code_review_comments: phonetics.classify_word handles 'L' position correctly (light vs dark) — confirmed by tests on 'little'.
MongoDB _id is correctly excluded from all list/get responses via projection {'_id': 0}.
Idempotency: laundry-list dedupes case-insensitively via normalize_word — verified.
TTS endpoint correctly checks audio_cache first, then proxies ElevenLabs synchronous SDK via asyncio.to_thread; on failure raises 502 with upstream detail (verified).
PDF upload validates extension and empty-text PDFs with proper 400 errors.
Pydantic v2 ConfigDict used; LLM fallback gracefully degrades to {} on import/parse failure (no upload crashes).
Minor: ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID has a default fallback constant in code AND in .env — defaults are fine here since config is also injected; not a security issue.
Minor: CMU pronouncing dict is loaded at import; OK for current scale. No N+1 DB issues observed.
seed_data_creation: Generated in-memory PDF via reportlab containing the dev sample text ('JANE: I want a little butter on my bread, mother. MARK: Better hurry, darling. The water is getting cold.'). Test scenes are deleted at fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 20 pytest tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_accent_coach.py. Run with: cd /app/backend && export $(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | xargs) && python -m pytest tests/test_accent_coach.py -v. Frontend already verified manually per main agent context. TTS test accepts both 200 and 502 — 502 is the current expected outcome on free-tier ElevenLabs.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. TTS 502 root-causes to ElevenLabs free-tier abuse-detection blocking cloud datacenter IPs (HTTP 401 'detected_unusual_activity'); the API correctly proxies the upstream error as a 502 with full detail. Mitigation: switch to a paid ElevenLabs subscription.
